title: High-profile autonomous agent demonstrations conceal human restarts, prompt scaffolding, and fragile edge cases
text: Forensic examination of vendor autonomous agent showcases demonstrates that public demonstrations frequently depend on hidden manual interventions, pre-scripted state restarts, and cherry-picked runs costing hundreds of dollars in trial attempts. Demonstrations measure peak prototype capability under ideal conditions, not autonomous operational reliability.
qualification: Single-case forensic deconstruction of an autonomous OS demonstration; illustrates common demonstration artifices but does not constitute an industry-wide comparative benchmark.

public_locator.value: Behind the seamless demonstration sat multiple restarts, uncredited prompt interventions, and over $900 in trial compute.
